images.name_stars_sky: A deep blue night sky full of stars forming a soft glowing swirl over quiet green hills, magical and personal, no letters.
images.old_town_valley: An ancient stone town in a green mountain valley at late afternoon, flat roofs, olive trees, peaceful but slightly gloomy clouds, nobody present.
images.empty_pedestal_shadow: An empty stone pedestal in a dim old courtyard with dry leaves on the ground and a single beam of light falling beside it, nothing on top, quiet atmosphere.
images.creation_wonder: A wondrous landscape showing the sun rising over the sea, waves, green cliffs, flowers and a waterfall all together, vibrant and full of life.
images.stone_block_tools: A plain block of grey stone with a chisel and hammer resting next to it on a workbench, dusty workshop, cold dull light.
images.few_lanterns_night: A few warm lanterns glowing on the doorsteps of three small houses in a dark quiet village at night, hopeful.
images.mountain_peace_morning: A lonely green mountain peak in soft golden morning mist, peaceful, honorable and calm, birds far away.
